notes: 3 photos: 1.jpg and 2.jpg are overhead menu boards (2.jpg is the widest, clearest view showing multiple boards; 1.jpg is a close crop of one board with conflicting Mega/Giga prices, likely an older or promo board, so 2.jpg's prices were used). 3.jpg is an unrelated cookbook page (goat's-milk hot fudge sauce recipe), not a menu, and was skipped.
